modules.description: Tracks nozzle, bed, belt, rail, dock, and fan maintenance from print history.
modules.name: Maintenance reminders

modules.description: Pause, resume, cancel, set temperatures, home axes, and send G-code.
modules.name: Printer control

modules.description: WS2812 rings, or push the same state to a WLED strip you already own.
modules.name: Dock status rings

modules.description: Optical filament colour check before a print starts.
modules.name: Right colour loaded?

modules.description: Alerts on print finish/fail via ntfy.sh, Discord, or Telegram. Respects quiet hours.
modules.name: Push notifications

modules.description: Tracks spools on hand, flags files needing a colour you don't have, nudges on idle spools.
modules.name: Filament inventory

modules.description: Combines maintenance, dock, and colour status into one verdict before you print.
modules.name: Pre-print sanity check

modules.description: Compares the next job against your history and flags likely causes from past failures.
modules.name: What changed?

modules.description: Reads Moonraker's update-status API and flags when Klipper or Moonraker have updates.
modules.name: Update checker

modules.description: One-click archive of this dashboard's settings and history to a local file.
modules.name: Config backup

modules.description: Brings the printer's camera feed in, with a watchdog that flags a frozen stream.
modules.name: Camera bridge

modules.description: Plays the camera with almost no delay through go2rtc, a separate program you install. Falls back to the normal camera feed if it can't connect.
modules.name: Low-latency camera (WebRTC)

modules.description: Prices filament by material and adds electricity, for past jobs and the one currently running.
modules.name: Print cost calculator

modules.description: Pushes dock ring colors to a WLED-flashed LED strip you already own, over WLED's JSON API.
modules.name: WLED bridge

modules.description: Publishes printer state to Home Assistant as REST sensors — no MQTT broker, no custom component.
modules.name: Home Assistant bridge

modules.description: An at-a-glance overview of every printer, and switching the whole dashboard between them.
modules.name: Printer fleet

modules.description: Connects to the printers you add by address, through Moonraker's own HTTP and WebSocket API, and keeps their live state current.
modules.name: Printer connection (Moonraker)

modules.description: Select several printers and pause, resume, cancel, home or preheat them together; send files between queues; the farm's print history over time.
modules.name: Fleet command center

modules.description: Your G-code, 3MF and STL files with thumbnails, a G-code viewer with small edits, and a 3D viewer.
modules.name: Print file library

modules.description: Files to print one after another, each checked by the Confirm Print gate before it starts.
modules.name: Print queue

modules.description: Local when-this-then-that rules: temperatures, print events, filament and maintenance to alerts, lights, Home Assistant or pause.
modules.name: Automations

modules.description: Places an STL or 3MF model at real size on your desk through the phone camera. Works on Android/WebXR browsers; iOS Safari has no equivalent.
modules.name: View on your desk (AR)

modules.description: Turns MakerWorld and NexPrint projects into Snapmaker Orca projects set up for the U1.
modules.name: 3MF converter

modules.description: Keeps a camera frame every few layers and plays the print back as a flipbook in the browser.
modules.name: Time-lapse flipbook

modules.description: Chamber temperature over the last half hour, where Klipper reports a chamber sensor.
modules.name: Chamber climate

modules.description: Turns a photo into a colour-layered relief model from your own filament colours, previewed in 3D and saved to the library.
modules.name: Photo-to-Print Studio

modules.description: Slices STL and 3MF models with OrcaSlicer, a separate program you install, and puts the G-code in the library or queue.
modules.name: Auto-print pipeline

modules.description: A simulated farm of any size with scripted jams, runouts, network drops and wear, to watch the whole dashboard react. Demo data only.
modules.name: Farm sandbox

modules.description: Offers to pick up on your phone exactly where another device left off.
modules.name: Continue on another device

presets.about: A printing printer jams 10 minutes in. Watch the fleet card turn red, the print fail in history, and any "print failed" rule fire.

presets.about: One printer stops answering for 15 minutes. Its card keeps its last report, labelled stale; commands to it fail in words; then it comes back.

presets.about: Someone loads the wrong colour on the active toolhead of a running print. The filament-mismatch rule fires, and Confirm Print blocks the next start.
